research_question: What contextual repair effectiveness, validation behavior, and efficiency does a strong contemporary coding agent achieve on the unchanged ten-project reference subset under the same localization and evaluator budget?
null_hypothesis: No directional superiority hypothesis is preregistered because this is a limited contemporary reference rather than the paper's primary method claim.
alternative_hypothesis: No directional superiority hypothesis is preregistered; all effect directions, including ties or reference-agent advantages, will be reported.
research_objective: Provide a runnable contemporary coding-agent reference while preserving the original ten-project membership and avoiding a claim that HapRepair must outperform agents.

model.temperature: not explicitly configurable through the frozen Codex harness
model.nondeterminism_note: A single run remains potentially nondeterministic even without an exposed sampling-temperature control.
model.repeat_policy: Two independent clean workspaces; provider seed is not exposed.

common_contract.source_diff_gate: Validation requires a real ArkTS/TypeScript source diff relative to the active-round snapshot.
common_contract.target_coverage_gate: Every localized rule/file/location in the frozen active-round plan must be concretely repaired before validation.
common_contract.candidate_retention: Retain the active candidate after structural, public-API, namespace, configured build, or configured test failure and continue in place without consuming a HomeCheck validation scan.
common_contract.best_valid_selection: Before the evaluator-only final scan, restore the valid candidate with the lexicographically best score over final alerts, introduced alerts, changed source files, and round.
common_contract.build_test_policy: Use only evaluator gates frozen as available in the shared input manifest; otherwise label the project statically validated only.
common_contract.arkts_diagnostic_policy: For configured builds, compiler ignoreWarning applies only to ArkTS checker diagnostics; later failures remain fatal.

scheduling.round_target_policy: Repair every currently localized alert location before validation.
scheduling.complete_cluster_policy: Inspect every affected file and jointly account for same-entity or interacting-rule-family findings.
scheduling.preflight_policy: Structural, public-API, namespace, build, and test failures are repaired in the same active round without consuming a scan.
scheduling.homogeneous_batch_policy: Batch only after demonstrating common preconditions and invariants.
scheduling.interaction_policy: Feed residual and introduced findings into later rounds.
scheduling.resume_budget_policy: A resumed active round inherits only unused turns from its original allowance; every existing JSONL attempt consumes one slot.

retrieval.isolation: The coding-agent-only baseline receives frozen HomeCheck locations and the same evaluator feedback/gates but no HapRepair Skill or references.

dataset.source_identity: Per-project commit, Git tree OID, and source-content tree hash are frozen and rechecked at condition start.
dataset.selection: Complete frozen 35-project population; no outcome-based subset.

execution.retry_policy: No stochastic condition is rerun automatically. Terminal semantic or gate failures remain formal failures. Infrastructure interruptions are preserved for audit before any replacement decision.
execution.abort_policy: Continue after auditable terminal condition failures; stop launching new work only when a condition lacks a durable terminal manifest.
execution.resume_policy: Scheduler resume launches untouched tasks only. Incomplete condition directories block automatic reuse. Active-round resume cannot refresh the turn allowance.
execution.old_run_import_policy: Forbidden for all candidates, traces, and metrics.

stop_condition: Stop early on zero accepted target findings; otherwise stop after five post-edit validation scans or bounded active-round exhaustion.
abandonment_condition: Preserve a formal failure on drift, restricted access, scanner failure, or bounded active-round exhaustion.

reporting.primary: Report the full ten-project contextual reference aggregate alongside matching HapRepair Skill results from EXP-HAPSKILL-35; do not rerun Skill conditions merely to form pairs.
reporting.sensitivity: Also report the nine-project aggregate after excluding development-exposed wifi_testapp.
reporting.effect_direction: Report ties, regressions, and reference-agent advantages without reinterpretation as HapRepair improvements.

claim_boundary: This is a strong contemporary coding-agent reference, not the unique state of the art and not a preregistered superiority test. HomeCheck alert elimination is not semantic correctness.
